prompt.zh-TW: 從稅前淨利走到營業活動的現金流量，下列哪些是間接法會做的調整？
prompt.en: On the way from profit before tax to net cash from operating activities, which of the following are adjustments the indirect method makes?

feedback.zh-TW: 是。折舊讓利益變少，卻沒有付出現金，所以要加回。
feedback.en: Yes. Depreciation lowered profit without any cash being paid, so it is added back.

text.zh-TW: 把應收帳款增加的金額扣掉
text.en: Deduct the increase in trade receivables

feedback.zh-TW: 是。這部分的收入算進了利益，錢卻還沒收到，要扣掉。
feedback.en: Yes. That part of revenue is in profit but the cash has not arrived, so it is deducted.

text.zh-TW: 把向銀行借款收到的現金加進來
text.en: Add the cash received from a bank loan

feedback.zh-TW: 借款確實讓現金變多，這點沒錯。不過它和營業活動無關，會放在下面的籌資活動，不是從稅前淨利調整出來的。
feedback.en: The loan does increase cash, that much is right. But it has nothing to do with operating activities; it appears further down under financing and is not an adjustment to profit before tax.

text.zh-TW: 把買設備付出的現金扣掉
text.en: Deduct the cash paid for equipment

feedback.zh-TW: 買設備確實付了現金，這點沒錯。不過那是投資活動的支出，有自己的一段；營業活動只處理利益和日常收付之間的差異。
feedback.en: Equipment was indeed paid for in cash, that much is right. But that is an investing outflow with its own section; the operating section only deals with the gap between profit and day-to-day receipts and payments.

explanation.zh-TW: 間接法只修正「利益和營業現金不一樣」的地方：沒付現的費用要加回，例如{{option:o_zwrd}}；營運資金的變動要調整，例如{{option:o_9kck}}。{{option:o_tjec}}屬於{{term:tm_f9a4c6md}}，{{option:o_x6km}}屬於{{term:tm_9hrfpqem}}，各有自己的段落。
explanation.en: The indirect method corrects only the places where profit and operating cash differ: non-cash expenses are added back, as in {{option:o_zwrd}}, and working-capital changes are adjusted, as in {{option:o_9kck}}. {{option:o_tjec}} belongs to {{term:tm_f9a4c6md}} and {{option:o_x6km}} to {{term:tm_9hrfpqem}}, each in its own section.
